en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a line of uniformed soldiers standing at attention with rifles, likely on guard duty in front of a brick military building. A drummer stands to the left with a snare drum, and two officers or NCOs stand to the right observing. The image has a formal, posed composition typical of early 20th‑century military postcards. Red printed caption text appears at the bottom.
